tagline: Video calls seedha ek browser se doosre browser tak.
description: WebRTC do browsers ya apps ko ek doosre ko seedha audio aur video bhejne deta hai. Server sirf call ke descriptions badalne mein madad karta hai; phir STUN aur ICE home routers ke beech se path dhoondte hain, DTLS keys agree karta hai, aur SRTP encrypted media le jaata hai.
facts: ICE, STUN aur TURN ke saath

normal.name: Do gharon ke beech video call
normal.summary: Laptop friend ke phone ko call karta hai; dono normal home routers ke peeche hain, isliye direct path kaam karta hai.

steps.title: STUN se pucho: main kaun hoon?
steps.desc: Router jo public address deta hai wo pata karo
steps.detail: Laptop ko sirf apna private address 192.168.1.10 pata hai, jise internet pe koi reach nahi kar sakta. Wo ek public STUN server ko chhota sa STUN Binding Request bhejta hai. Server us address aur port ke saath reply karta hai jahan se usne request aati dekhi: home router ka public side.

quiz.q: Laptop ne 192.168.1.10:54321 se bheja. STUN server kaunsa address wapas report karega?
quiz.why: Home router ne source ko apne public address aur naye port se rewrite kar diya (NAT). Wahi rewritten address STUN server ko dikhta hai aur wo report karta hai.

steps.title: Offer bhejo
steps.detail: Browser ek SDP offer likhta hai: kaunse codecs use kar sakta hai (Opus audio, VP8 video), ICE username fragment aur password, uska certificate fingerprint, aur uske candidate addresses, jisme STUN ka abhi dhunda hua public address bhi hai. WebRTC ye nahi batata ki ye text kaise deliver karna hai, isliye app ise apne WebSocket pe, TLS ke andar, bhejti hai, aur server ise friend tak pahunchata hai.

quiz.q: WebRTC ka kaunsa hissa decide karta hai ki offer friend tak kaise pahunchega?
options: WebRTC mein kuch nahi: app apni pasand ka koi bhi channel chunti hai
quiz.why: Signalling app pe chhodi gayi hai. WebSocket common hai, lekin HTTP polling, chat message ya QR code bhi chalega.

steps.title: Answer wapas aata hai
steps.desc: Friend accept karke SDP answer bhejta hai
steps.detail: Friend Accept dabata hai. Unka browser wo codecs chunta hai jo dono sides support karte hain aur apne candidates, ICE credentials aur certificate fingerprint ke saath SDP answer likhta hai. Wo a=setup:active bhi kehta hai, jiska matlab friend ka phone baad mein DTLS handshake shuru karega.

steps.title: ICE connectivity checks
steps.desc: Dono sides ek doosre ke darwaze khatkhatate hain
steps.detail: Ab har side doosre ke candidate addresses ko seedha STUN Binding Requests bhejti hai. Bahar bhejne se aapke apne router mein ek hole bhi khulta hai, taaki doosri side ka check andar aa sake. Har check SDP ke ICE password se signed hota hai. Laptop control mein hai aur ye path chunne ke liye USE-CANDIDATE jodta hai.
facts: STUN Binding with USERNAME, PRIORITY, MESSAGE-INTEGRITY

quiz.q: Dono sides ko checks kyun bhejne padte hain, sirf laptop ko nahi?
options: Bahar bhejne se apne NAT mein mapping khulti hai, jisse doosri side ke packets andar aa sakte hain
STUN sirf ek direction mein kaam karta hai
Signalling server ise require karta hai
quiz.why: Home router sirf unhi addresses ke replies andar aane deta hai jinhe aap pehle bhej chuke ho. Dono lagbhag ek saath bhejein to dono routers hole kholte hain. Ise hole punching kehte hain.

steps.title: DTLS handshake
steps.desc: Naye path pe keys agree karo
steps.detail: Usi UDP path pe dono browsers DTLS handshake chalate hain, jo TLS hai lekin lost aur reordered datagrams jhel sakta hai. Dono ek self-signed certificate dikhate hain, aur har ek use us fingerprint se check karta hai jo doosre ne apne SDP mein rakha tha. use_srtp extension handshake se SRTP ki keys bhi banwata hai.

quiz.q: Certificates self-signed hain. Man in the middle ko apna certificate dikhane se kya rokta hai?
options: Kuch nahi, DTLS secure nahi hai
Har side certificate ko us fingerprint se compare karti hai jo TLS-protected signalling channel se SDP mein aaya tha
STUN server unhe sign karta hai
quiz.why: Fingerprint signalling server se TLS ke through aaya. Alag certificate uske saath match nahi karega aur call fail ho jaayegi. Trust signalling server pe tika hai.

steps.title: Video aur voice chalte hain
steps.desc: RTP packets, SRTP ki tarah encrypted
steps.detail: Media ab usi UDP path pe dono taraf chalta hai. Har packet mein padhne layak 12-byte RTP header hai jisme codec number, sequence number aur timestamp hai, taaki receiver reorder kar sake, loss pakad sake aur sahi moment pe play kar sake. Payload encrypted hai, aur end ka 10-byte tag proof deta hai ki kuch badla nahi.
facts: Opus, PT 111, 48 kHz clock, 20 ms per packet

quiz.q: Ek video frame 3 packets mein split hua. In 3 packets mein kya common hai?
quiz.why: Har packet ko agla sequence number milta hai, lekin ek frame ke saare tukdon ka timestamp same hota hai, kyunki wo video ke ek hi moment ke hain. Aakhri packet marker bit bhi set karta hai.

outro.title: Call connected, peer to peer
outro.text: Server ne sirf offer aur answer carry kiye. STUN ne public address dhoondha, ICE checks ne direct path prove kiya, DTLS ne fingerprints check karke keys banayi, aur ab SRTP voice aur video seedha do gharon ke beech le jaata hai.
facts: Sab kuch ke liye ek UDP port pair

turn.name: Dono symmetric NAT ke peeche: TURN use karo
turn.summary: Direct checks fail hote hain kyunki har router har destination ke liye naya port chunta hai, isliye call TURN relay se jaati hai.

steps.title: Checks kahin nahi pahunchte
steps.desc: Symmetric NAT hole punching tod deta hai
steps.detail: Is baar dono routers symmetric NATs hain, jo mobile networks aur offices mein aam hain. Wo har naye destination ke liye naya public port chunte hain. STUN ne jo port bataya wo sirf STUN server ki taraf valid hai, isliye usko bheje gaye checks doosra router drop kar deta hai.
facts: Symmetric (har destination ke liye naya port)

quiz.q: Dono taraf symmetric NAT ho to call ko aur kya jod sakta hai?
options: Ek public address wala relay jise dono sides bhejti hain (TURN)
quiz.why: Har side hamesha ek fixed public server ko bhej sakti hai. TURN server dono ke beech relay karta hai, isliye kisi ko doosre ka port guess nahi karna padta.

steps.title: Relay maango
steps.desc: TURN Allocate, pehle bina password ke
steps.detail: Laptop TURN server se relay address allocate karne ko kehta hai. TURN servers bandwidth khate hain, isliye login chahiye. Pehli request mein credentials nahi hote, aur server 401 se jawab deta hai, ek realm aur nonce ke saath jo agli koshish mein use hoga.

steps.title: Relay mil gaya
steps.detail: Laptop request ko username, realm, nonce aur password se bane MESSAGE-INTEGRITY hash ke saath repeat karta hai. App ko ye short-lived credentials apne server se mile the. TURN server laptop ke liye ek public relay port kholta hai aur batata hai.
facts: 600 s, call chalne tak refresh hota hai

quiz.q: Laptop apna naya relay address kahan rakhta hai taaki friend use kar sake?
options: Signalling server se bheje naye ICE candidate mein
Kahin nahi, friend guess karta hai
quiz.why: Ye bas ek aur ICE candidate hai (type relay). Ise signalling se friend ko trickle kiya jaata hai, aur ICE checks isse bhi kisi bhi path ki tarah chalte hain.

steps.title: Channel bind karo
steps.desc: Friend ke address ko chhota number do
steps.detail: TURN sirf unhi addresses ko relay karta hai jinki client ne permission di ho. ChannelBind wahi karta hai aur friend ke address ko channel 0x4000 bhi assign karta hai. Ab se laptop media ko poore STUN message ki jagah chhote 4-byte ChannelData header mein lapet sakta hai.

steps.title: Relay se media
steps.desc: ICE, DTLS aur SRTP sab relay pe chalte hain
steps.detail: Relay ke through ICE checks succeed hote hain, DTLS uske upar chalta hai, aur phir SRTP flow hota hai. Laptop har packet TURN server ko channel 0x4000 ke saath bhejta hai, aur server andar ke bytes apne relay port se friend ko forward karta hai. Relay media padh nahi sakta: wo ab bhi SRTP hai, end to end encrypted.
facts: Nahi, wo sirf SRTP dekhta hai
Relay saari bandwidth ka kharcha uthata hai

quiz.q: TURN server har packet forward karta hai. Kya wo video dekh sakta hai?
options: Nahi, DTLS keys sirf do browsers mein hain
Sirf agar wo usi country mein ho
quiz.why: DTLS handshake relay ke through end to end chalta hai, isliye SRTP keys TURN server tak kabhi nahi pahunchtin. Wo bas encrypted bytes hilata hai.

outro.title: Relay ke through connected
outro.text: Jab dono sides symmetric NAT ke peeche hon, hole punching fail hoti hai. ICE relay candidate pe fall back karta hai: TURN server har side ko public address deta hai aur packets forward karta hai. Call thodi zyada delay ke saath chalti hai, aur media end to end encrypted rehta hai.

cheatsheet.title: Building blocks
items: Codecs, keys fingerprint, candidates describe karne wala text
Har address pair try karta hai, sabse achha working rakhta hai
Aapka public address batata hai; checks ke liye bhi use hota hai
Jab koi direct path na chale to relay
UDP pe TLS; SRTP keys banata hai
Encrypted payload + auth tag wala RTP
